stories.title: Fraudsters posing as police cybercrime officers target cryptocurrency in North Wales
stories.summary: Cryptocurrency holders in Flintshire and across North Wales are being warned about fraudsters who phone pretending to be police cybercrime officers. North Wales Police said the callers falsely claim to be based in Dolgellau and are trying to steal cryptocurrency. At least two potential victims have been targeted this week, according to the force. stories.title: Airbus Broughton workers take on Moel Famau charity walk for men’s health
stories.summary: Workers from Airbus Broughton have walked up Moel Famau to raise money for Movember. Staff from across the business took part in the charity walk, which was organised by Elfyn Davies. stories.title: Broughton flood work delayed as council rejects call for more defence money
stories.summary: Flood defence work in Broughton that was due to start in the summer has been put back, with a new start now proposed for December or January, a councillor has told Flintshire County Council.
